For the purpose of this explanation, I will describe how a public library system works, as it is a common and accessible public system.

A public library system is a network of libraries and resources that work together to provide access to information and reading materials to a community. This system typically includes a central library, branch libraries, and mobile libraries. 

At the core of a public library system is the central library, which usually houses the most extensive collection of books, media, and other resources. This library is often located in a central or easily accessible part of town, and is open to all residents of the community. The central library employs librarians and other staff to manage the collections and assist patrons in finding information.
